description.value: Coast Fort St. John Hotel is a 2-storey downtown hotel in northeastern BC's largest city, situated just off the Alaska Highway (Highway 97). It is part of the Coast Hotels chain and markets itself as a full-amenity base for both business travellers and those exploring the Peace River Region. Touring cyclists would find free parking (including RV-sized stalls), free hot breakfast, on-site laundry, and complimentary passes to a nearby full-service pool and gym complex.

address.value: 10103 98 Avenue, Fort St. John, BC V1J 1P8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms an active, open property. Free Wi-Fi is explicitly stated on the website ('free wi-fi in your room and throughout the hotel'), contradicting the OSM tag internet_access:fee=customers; website takes precedence. On-site laundry is confirmed ('take advantage of our on-site laundry facilities'). No mention of bike-specific storage, bike procedures, e-bike charging, or any other cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the website content.
